title: Motherson eyes bigger India play with global technologies to drive growth
description:
Auto components major Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd (SAMIL) aims to leverage technologies acquired through its global expansion to tap emerging opportunities in India's automotive market, as higher product standards and the shift to stricter emission norms drive demand for advanced solutions.
The strategy is part of its broader Vision 2030 ambition to achieve USD 108 billion in topline gross revenue by 2029-30.
In an interview with PTI, Pankaj Mital, Whole-time Director and President, and Gandharv Tongia, Group Chief Financial Officer, outlined the company's growth priorities, including bringing globally acquired technologies to India, expanding its presence across business segments and geographies, and strengthening its customer relationships.
